title: Using machine learning metrics to provide deeper insights into the performance of choice models
abstract: arXiv:2609.20655v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) techniques are increasingly drawing interest in the choice modelling (CM) field. The focus has primarily been on comparing the performance of these contrasting approaches or on improving behavioural insights for ML techniques, rather than translating ideas from one field into the other. In the present paper, we specifically focus on knowledge transfer from ML into CM in the context of model performance evaluation. In CM, model performance is typically evaluated using log-likelihood and related indicators, which are aggregate fit metrics that focus on overall fit. Conversely, in ML, the focus is on alternative-level misclassifications and correct classifications, which provide a more nuanced view of the results. translated_title: 使用机器学习指标为选择模型的性能提供更深入的洞察
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）技术正日益引起选择建模（CM）领域的兴趣。现有研究主要集中于比较这两种不同方法的性能，或改进机器学习技术的行为洞察，而非将一个领域的思想迁移到另一个领域。本文特别关注在模型性能评估背景下，从机器学习向选择建模的知识转移。在选择建模中，模型性能通常使用对数似然及相关指标进行评估，这些是侧重于整体拟合的聚合拟合指标。相反，在机器学习中，评估重点在于选项层面的错误分类和正确分类，这为结果提供了更细致的视角。为了弥合这两种方法，我们探索使用概率版的混淆矩阵，该矩阵报告模型在给定真实选项的条件下预测每个选项的平均概率。
tldr: 本文将机器学习中的混淆矩阵概念引入选择建模领域，提出概率版混淆矩阵来补充传统的对数似然评估方法，从而为选择模型的性能提供更细致、更深入的评估视角。
en_tdlr: This paper transfers the confusion matrix concept from machine learning into choice modelling, proposing a probabilistic confusion matrix to complement traditional log-likelihood metrics and provide a more nuanced evaluation of choice model performance.
